author: Ruohang Feng (rh@vonng.com)
description: Adapted from Pigsty pgsql/pgsql-instance.json @745a4ea (Apache-2.0) for pigsty-lite native metrics.

panels.description: TPS (1m) of each database on this postgres server
panels.title: Database TPS

panels.description: PostgreSQL active SQL time divided by host CPU count over 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total{job="postgres",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[1m])) / on (cluster,instance) count by (cluster,instance) (count by (cluster,instance,cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

sum by (cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total{job="postgres",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / on (cluster,instance) count by (cluster,instance) (count by (cluster,instance,cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

sum by (cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total{job="postgres",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[15m])) / on (cluster,instance) count by (cluster,instance) (count by (cluster,instance,cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Active SQL Time per CPU
